title: DFAA-MemoryNet
description: DFAA-MemoryNet is a dual-task convolutional encoder-decoder for modelling near-surface soil-moisture response to drought-flood abrupt alternation under prescribed hydroclimatic forcing. This model-only release includes the architecture, predictor utilities, soil-moisture-memory inputs, training and normalization helpers, spatial inference, evaluation metrics, and reusable validation split utilities.
